reports.title: Independent Practitioner's Limited Assurance Report under SAE 3000
reports.nature: Limited assurance under SAE 3000; report says aligned with ISAE 3000 (Revised).
reports.scope: Statement of Institutional Claims, Annexure I assertions A1-A6, B1, C1-C4, D1-D2, measured under Annexure II Board-adopted criteria.

verificationReceipt.description: Unmodified two-page ICAI portal verification PDF supplied by the owner; exact UDIN and particulars visually matched to this page.

reports.title: Independent Chartered Accountant's Report of Factual Findings
reports.nature: Agreed procedures under SRS 4400, adapted to non-financial information; factual findings with no assurance conclusion.
reports.scope: 12 annexure items; factual findings confined to those matters and company records produced.

verificationReceipt.description: Unmodified two-page ICAI portal verification PDF supplied by the owner; exact UDIN and particulars visually matched to this page.

claims.title: Cumulative services
claims.summary: 31 million+ documented therapy services: floor subject to independent limited assurance; 31,052,382 recorded in the related factual-findings report at 17 July 2026.
claims.coverage: Limited assurance on >=31,000,000 floor; 31,052,382 factual finding
claims.definition: Therapy service includes 1:1 therapy, structured assessments, screenings and parent training. It does not mean 31 million independently verified successful therapy sessions.

claims.title: Beneficiary / family registrations
claims.summary: 792,614 beneficiary/family registrations recorded under the stated counting criteria at 17 July 2026.
claims.coverage: Limited assurance on >=790,000 floor; 792,614 factual finding
claims.definition: Unique beneficiary or family registration counted once under the criteria. Not a separate count of 792,614 unique children, households with home therapy, or proven clinical outcomes.

claims.title: Operational centres
claims.summary: 49 centres met the report's operational-centre criteria at the cutoff; seven were visited physically.
claims.coverage: Limited assurance on >=40 floor; 49 factual finding
claims.definition: Operational means a location with lease/ownership rights, location registration/listing, staffing roster and platform activity in the preceding 90 days. The report names Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Delhi.

claims.title: Wider centre network
claims.summary: Handout p14 itself distinguishes 49 operational centres from network figure 70+.
claims.coverage: Not established by these reports
claims.definition: The handout distinguishes the wider 70+ network from 49 centres meeting the operational criteria. Ownership and franchise status require their own records.

sourcePages.sae3000: No 70+ or wholly-owned-network assertion; A3 uses >=40 and allows lease or ownership.

claims.title: Network-trained practitioners
claims.summary: 2,293 network-trained and certified practitioners recorded; 83% women, at the cutoff.
claims.coverage: Limited assurance on floors; 2,293 and 83% factual findings
claims.definition: Certification means completion of the network's defined training/certification pathway. It does not establish current employment, RCI registration, or independent professional licensure for every practitioner.

claims.title: Structured developmental records
claims.summary: 2.7 billion+ structured platform records recorded in the SRS 4400 factual findings; the SAE 3000 report covers a 2.5 billion+ floor.
claims.coverage: Limited assurance on 2.5B+ floor; 2.7B+ separate factual finding
claims.definition: Structured records/events: session logs, assessment observations, technique ratings, sensor events or equivalent mapped fields. Not unique people, independent trial observations, or established deduplicated AI-training examples; no general IT-controls audit.

sourcePages.sae3000: p4 A5 assures >=2,500,000,000 floor; p6 data-point definition; p7 IT reliance

claims.title: Institutional operating history
claims.summary: Criteria begin with incorporation in 2016; corporate renaming effective 18 May 2017.
claims.coverage: Only operations since incorporation in 2016 covered
claims.definition: The reports do not establish 16+ institutional years or 16-year longitudinal coverage.

claims.coverage: Documentary classification claim within stated scope
claims.definition: This is reported documentary checking, not an ICAI-issued regulatory approval or independent clinical-efficacy conclusion.

claims.title: Quality and security certificates
claims.summary: Original certificates and certification-body confirmation recorded.
claims.coverage: Documentary certification claims within stated scope

claims.title: Patent applications
claims.summary: 16 distinct applications per filing receipts, comprising 13 PCT and 3 Indian, without duplicate counting across phases; lead PCT checked on Patentscope.
claims.coverage: Limited assurance on >=13 PCT floor; 16 distinct applications factual finding
claims.definition: Applications filed, not patents granted; no conclusion on novelty, enforceability, global exclusivity or every invention described.

claims.title: Methodology and protocol DOI records
claims.summary: The practitioner checked the two cited DOI records and agreement of their stated particulars.
claims.coverage: Publication existence/content-agreement within scope
claims.definition: The audit procedures do not replicate statistics or establish completed independent CRO validation. The second work is explicitly a validation protocol. DOI existence/content match does not establish journal peer review.
